deliverable.shape: Per-lens evidence assessment followed by one synthesized decision

panel.brief: Frontend delivery lens: component and state boundaries, fit with existing frontend patterns, and the delivery cost of each fix the other lenses ask for.
UX lens: flow friction, state coverage (empty, loading, error), and interaction patterns, with findings ranked by severity.
Accessibility lens: keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, and focus barriers, each mapped to a WCAG 2.2 criterion and ranked by user impact.
Localisation lens: hardcoded strings, text expansion, RTL layout, and locale-aware dates, numbers, and plurals.

candidate_panel.brief: Performance lens, when the surface has a rendering, bundle-size, or Core Web Vitals risk.
iOS lens, when the surface ships natively on iOS: HIG fit, Dynamic Type, and VoiceOver behaviour.
Android lens, when the surface ships natively on Android: Material fit, font scaling, and TalkBack behaviour.
